why: Written for the redaction test, and the reason it exists is that the reference
corpora cannot prove anything about redaction: 876 input fields across both
fixture products contain no email, phone, card, sort code, postcode, IBAN or
National Insurance number at all. Their authors wrote clean synthetic text, so a
test over them passes whether the redactor works or not.
Each case below carries the literal strings that must not survive, written out by
hand rather than found with the same regular expressions the redactor uses. That
is what makes the assertion non-circular: the test checks these exact substrings
are absent from the stored text, so a pattern that silently stops matching fails
the test even though redact() and find_pii() would still agree with each other.
The last case is the honest limit. A name and a bereavement are personal data by
any reading and no pattern will mask them, which is why an input is stored only
for a case that did not pass, and why the untouched conversation stays at the

cases.input: Email me at jo.smith+bank@example.co.uk, or ring 07700 900123.
My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was declined at the till again.
Pay it to sort code 12-34-56, account 87654321, please.
Send the letter to SW1A 1AA. My NI number is JG 12 34 56 A.
Transfer from GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 19 failed from 10.0.0.255.
Card 4111-1111-1111-1111 and +44 7700 900123 on the same account.
My husband Daniel passed away last month and I need to close his account.
cases.note: No pattern masks a name or a bereavement. This case documents the limit rather than asserting a capability.
